title: Lesson 22: Building Without a Framework: the Agent Loop by Hand in 100 Lines
description: Lesson 21 ended on a quiet note: sometimes you don't need a framework at all. This lesson makes that concrete. You write the loop yourself, in roughly a hundred lines, with nothing but an LLM API and a while loop. You see the canonical agent loop in real code, you build a working agent with two tools, you learn the one ordering mistake that trips up every beginner, and you find out exactly where a hand-rolled loop runs out of room and a framework starts to earn its complexity.
